shared_elements: elaborate headdress / head ornament above the face
necklace or pectoral ornament at the throat/chest
arms bent with hands brought onto the chest or abdomen
bilaterally symmetrical composition about a vertical axis
rows of small repeated bead-like elements
low-relief incised detailing over the body
justification: Both depict a single frontal, symmetrical anthropomorphic figure whose head with a broad headdress sits directly above a torso bearing a collar/pectoral, with the arms bent so the hands meet on the chest or belly, and both use flat schematic low-relief incision with discs and rows of bead-like elements as filler ornament. They differ in specifics: B's figure has a large lobed, radiating headdress and wing- or feather-like flanking projections and clearly drawn crossed legs, while A's is a blocky columnar figure whose ornament reduces to a plain hat-like cap, a large single chest disc and broad plain bands, with no wings or legs shown.
